amazon.behavior: Amazons will always try to keep a distance from any attacker. They will try to lure you into bigger packs of amazons!

ancient scarab.abilities: Melee (0-210), Distance Poison attack (17-145), Poison Storm (poisons you starting at 26 hp/turn), Paralyze, Haste, Summons 0-3 Larva.
ancient scarab.behavior: Ancient Scarabs chase the enemy and use deadly poison storms that can paralyze or poison players. They will fight until death, and can retarget.

ashmunrah.abilities: Melee, Summons 0-3 Green Djinns and 0-2 Ancient Scarabs, appears as an Ancient Scarab, Invisible, Self-Healing.
ashmunrah.behavior: Malicious, will make all efforts to destroy intruders.

banshee.abilities: Melee (0-352), Distance Fighting Great Musical Bomb (100-200), Life Drain (150-270), Paralysis, Self-Healing.

behemoth.behavior: Behemoths attack their enemies and chase them with their great speed.

beholder.abilities: Melee, Fire attacks 0-45 damage, HMM 0-45 damage, Poison attacks 0-45 damage, SDs 0-40 damage, Life Drain 0-45 damage, Mana Drain 0-25 mana, Summon 0-6 Skeletons.
beholder.behavior: The beholder will back away from its opponent, using all sorts of spells, and usually summons skeletons which will attempt to surround the attacker.

black knight.behavior: The Black Knight fights until death and throws spears when the enemy tries to escape.

blue djinn.abilities: Melee (0-110), Distance Fire Attacks (50-105), Electrifies You (25 dmg for 3 turns), Makes you drunk, Cancel Invisibility, Turns you into a rabbit.
blue djinn.behavior: Blue Djinns use melee and use their Fire Attacks when the Opponent Tries to Escape.

bone beast.abilities: Melee (0-200), Berserk-like Poison attack, Berserk-like Life Drain attack (25-45),Envenom (25-65), Self-Healing
bone beast.behavior: Bonebeast do not run away in low health.

bug.behavior: They don't run in low Health.

cave rat.behavior: Cave Rats run when they have very low health.

cobra.abilities: Melee (Poison) 5 hp per second, Spits Poison 1 hp per second.
cobra.behavior: Cobras run away in red health.

crypt shambler.behavior: It will chase the intruders until dead.

cyclops.behavior: Cyclopses do not run when in low health, and retarget frequently.

deathslicer.abilities: Melee (0-500), Energy Exori (200-400), Invisible Energy Beam (100-200)
deathslicer.behavior: Will get as close as possible to you, attacking with it's strong melee attacks and heavy energy spells.

deer.behavior: Non-offensive creature, they always run when a player is on screen.

demon.abilities: Melee(0-470), Great Fireballs(100-250), Great Energy Beams(300-420), Mana Drain, Self-Healing, Summons Fire Elementals.
demon.behavior: '''Demons''' attack the enemy with extremely powerful attacks until the enemy is dead.

demon skeleton.behavior: They are slow and rather unintelligent.

demongoblin.behavior: They run away when they are in Red health.

dipthrah.abilities: Melee (0-800), Hot Water Explosion (0-600), Mana Drain (up to 450 mana), Summons 0-4 Priestesses, causes mass drunkeness, Poison, Self-Healing,
dipthrah.behavior: Malicious, will make all efforts to destroy intruders.

dog.behavior: Dogs normally follow you around but they run on low health.

dragon.behavior: Dragons are known to retarget. This often causes shooters in a team hunt to be burned or killed. A dragon will run away from attackers when its hitpoints bar is in very low yellow. They are also known for spamming, sometimes called "tripling" (using all 3 attacks simultaneously on the same opponent).

dragon lord.abilities: Melee (0-200), Fireballs (100-175), Fire Wave (150-250), Firebombs, Self-Healing.
dragon lord.behavior: Dragon Lords attack their opponents viciously with deadly fire attacks. They run in low health.

dwarf.behavior: Dwarves do not run when in low health.

dwarf geomancer.abilities: Melee (0-100), Mana Drain (0-80), Distance Fighting (Boulder 0-120), Self-Healing (fast)
dwarf geomancer.behavior: Dwarf Geomancers chase the enemy until death.

dwarf guard.behavior: Dwarf Guards chase the opponent until death.

dwarf soldier.behavior: Dwarf Soldiers do not run when in low health.

efreet.abilities: Melee (0-110), Fire Attacks (? - 110), Energy Attacks (? - 120), Energy Berserk, Self-Healing, Summons 0-2 Green Djinns
efreet.behavior: Efreets are a Higher Ranked Green Djinn and are the counterparts of Marids.

elder beholder.abilities: Melee, Life Drain, Mana Drain, Paralysis, Fire, Energy, Poison and Physical distance attacks (0-85?), Energy Beam (130-300?), Soulfire, Sudden Death, Summons 0 - 6 Gazers and 0 - 4 Crypt Shamblers.
elder beholder.behavior: Tries to keep a distance from its attacker, but does not run in low health.

elf.behavior: Elves are fierce warriors and do not run even when they are in low health.

elf arcanist.abilities: Melee (0-?), Arrows (0-70+), Heavy Magic Missile (30-50), Sudden Death (0-65), Self Healing (55)
elf arcanist.behavior: Elf Arcanist run from the opponent while attacking. They heal very quickly during a battle.

elf scout.behavior: Elf Scouts do not run when in low health. They keep a distance while attacking.

fire devil.behavior: Fire Devils can be dangerous for low levels. They attack at a certain distance. Therefore, if you approach them, they will run away.

fire elemental.behavior: Fire elementals can kill mages fast, so kill it before it kills you!

flamethrower.behavior: Flamethrowers shoot fire at their targets. They are fixed in position, unable to move.

frost troll.behavior: They Run when they have Low Health.

gargoyle.behavior: Gargoyles run when they have 30 hp or less.

ghost.behavior: Ghosts do not run when in low health.

ghoul.behavior: Ghouls don't run on low health.

giant spider.abilities: Melee(0-280), throws Poison Fields, Poison (starts from 5-7 per turn), Haste, Summons 0-2 Poison Spiders
giant spider.behavior: One of the fastest monsters, with the speed of a level 65 when using haste. They rush down opponents, spit poison fields and summon poison spiders. Their spiders will sometimes appear in front of a runner, blocking their path, and they will push/kill the Poison Spiders they summon in order to reach you and attack you with melee. Be sure to kill these spiders off first as they will break your shielding. They have a terrifyingly low attention span, switching targets often. Common lure in Plains of Havoc.

goblin.behavior: They run away when they are in Red health.

green djinn.abilities: Melee (0-110), Distance Fire Attacks (50-105), Electrifies You (25 dmg for 3 turns), Makes you drunk, Cancel Invisibility, Transforms you into a rat.
green djinn.behavior: Green Djinns use strong melee when close to their opponents, and Energy Attacks when the opponent is at a distance.

hero.behavior: Heroes attack the enemy with deadly hits and shoot them with arrows when they try to escape.

hunter.behavior: Hunters run when in low health.

hyaena.behavior: Hyaenas run at exactly half Hp (30hp).

larva.behavior: Larvas do not run when they are in low health.

lich.abilities: Paralysis, Melee (0-75), Life Drain Beam (140-190), Summons 0-4 Bonebeasts, Poison Beam, Life Drain (200-245), Life Drain Berserk (130-180).
lich.behavior: The Lich will chase the enemy while summoning Bonebeasts and casting various ''Unknown Spells''.

lion.behavior: Lions run away in red Health.

magicthrower.behavior: Magicthrowers shoot poison at their targets. They are fixed in position, unable to move.

mahrdis.abilities: Melee (0-400), Fire Exori (150-800), Physical Distance Attack (0-600), Fire Distance Attack (0-600), Explosion Wave (0?), Poisons (starting with upto 3 hp per turn), Summons 0-4 Fire Elementals, Paralysis, Great Firebomb, Self-Healing.
mahrdis.behavior: Malicious, will make all efforts to destroy inturuders.

marid.abilities: Melee (0-90), Energy Berserk (30-90), summons (0-2) Blue Djinns, makes you Drunk, Electrifies you (25 dmg for 3 turns), Paralyzes you, Distance Energy Attacks (100-250), Self Healing
marid.behavior: Marid seems to be a Higher Ranked Blue Djinn.

minotaur.behavior: Minotaurs do not run when in low health.

minotaur archer.abilities: Distance Fighting (3 Bolts per turn), Melee (0-25)
minotaur archer.behavior: Mino Archer run when in low health.

minotaur guard.behavior: Minotaur Guards do not run when in low health. It will kill other creatures and move objects in the way to get to you, so it's useless to block them with weak creatures or objects and shoot from the distance. It sometimes also retargets.

minotaur mage.abilities: HMM (0-50), Fire Missile (0-100) and Energy Field, Melee (0-20).
minotaur mage.behavior: Minotaur Mages do not run when in low health.

morguthis.abilities: Melee (0-1000), Sudden Death Berserk (300-500), Berserk (~400), Summons 0-3 Heroes, Invisible, Self-Healing.
morguthis.behavior: Malicious; will make all efforts to destroy intruders.

mummy.abilities: Melee (0-85), Poison (starting at 3 damage per turn), Paralyze, Life Drain (0-50).

necromancer.abilities: Life Drain (50-100), Distance Poison attack (30-100), Poisons for 0-15 HP/turn, Self-Healing, Summons up to 2 Ghouls, Ghosts and Mummies
necromancer.behavior: Necromancers distance themselves from their opponent, shoot a distance poison attack and summon undead creatures.

omruc.abilities: Arrows (100-500), Poison Arrows (100-500), Burst Arrows (100-500), Summons 0-4 Stalkers, Paralyze, Invisible, Self-Healing.
omruc.behavior: Malicious, will make all efforts to destroy intruders.

orc.behavior: Orcs run away at red health.

orc berserker.behavior: Orc Berserkers chase the enemy with their great speed until death.

orc leader.behavior: Orc leaders chase the enemy while throwing Throwing Knifes at them.

orc shaman.abilities: Melee (0-15?) Energy Missile (20-30), Fire Missiles (9-41), Self-Healing, Summons Snakes (0-4).
orc shaman.behavior: An Orc Shaman does run when in low health.

orc spearman.behavior: Orc Spearmen run when an enemy gets near. They will retarget on multiple player.

orc warlord.behavior: The Orc Warlord will chase the enemy while throwing stars and they can retarget.

orc warrior.behavior: Orc Warriors run when in low health.

pig.behavior: They don't attack and run from people.

plaguethrower.behavior: '''Plaguethrowers''' will shoot poison attacks on you until you die, or run away from them. Also, the '''Plaguethrowers''' won't chase you, due to it's inability to move.

poison spider.abilities: Melee (0-20), Poison with 1 hp per turn

polar bear.behavior: Polar Bears run in dark red health.

priestess.abilities: Melee (0-75), SDs (0-120), Mana Drain (10-170), Summons Ghouls, Self-Healing
priestess.behavior: Priestess' attack enemies from a distance.

rabbit.behavior: Rabbits run from any human contact.

rahemos.abilities: Melee (0-750), Energy Attack (200-600), Sudden Death (0-500), Summons 0-1 Demon, Makes you Drunk, Poisons (starting with upto 3 hp per turn), Paralysis, Appears as a Demon, Turns you into a Pig, Self-Healing.
rahemos.behavior: Malicious, he will make all efforts to destroy intruders.

rat.behavior: Runs away when 5 or less hp left.

rotworm.behavior: Rotworms move slowly and have no distance attack, so they are not very deadly unless you are surrounded.

scarab.abilities: Melee (0-75), Poison Hit (0-35) (Does NOT poison you), Poison Fields, Haste
scarab.behavior: Scarabs run at 85 hp. If a weak creature (such as a Larva) is blocking it's path, the scarab will kill the larva in order to reach you.

scorpion.abilities: Melee (0-50), Poison up to 17hp per turn and gradually reducing
scorpion.behavior: Scorpions run when in low red health (~5 hp remaining).

shredderthrower.behavior: A Shredderthrower will attack you until you die or run away.

skeleton.behavior: Skeletons are weak and easy for any player with decent armor. Can be blocked by both parcels and God Flowers.

snake.abilities: Melee (0-5), Poison with 1 hp damage per turn and doing about 15 hp
snake.behavior: Doesn't run when in low health.

stalker.behavior: Stalkers do not run when low on health.

stone golem.behavior: Stone Golems do not run when in low health.

swamp troll.abilities: Melee, Poison with 1 HP per turn.
swamp troll.behavior: They run when they are with low health.

thalas.abilities: Melee (0-900), Poison Hit (0-650), Poison Wave (0-600), Poison Bomb (Poisons you, starting with upto 34 hp per turn), Summons 0-8 Slimes, Paralyze, Self-Healing.
thalas.behavior: Malicious, will make all efforts to destroy intruders.

troll.behavior: They Run when they have low Health.

vampire.behavior: Vampires travel relatively fast, this combined with paralysis makes them difficult to run from. Vampires will retarget, it's best to keep the blocker between the vampire and the weaker individuals. They can appear as bats.

vashresamun.abilities: Melee (0-750), Great Musical Bomb (0-750), Poisons (starting with upto 3 hp per turn), Paralysis, Summons 0-2 Banshees, Self-Healing.
vashresamun.behavior: Malicious, will make all efforts to destroy intruders.

war wolf.behavior: War Wolves do not run when in low health.

warlock.abilities: Melee (0-130), Burst Arrow (0-180; fire damage), Fire Field Explosion, Energy Missile (0-100; physical damage), Great Energy Beam (150-230), Paralyze, Invisibility, Self-Healing, Summons 0-1 Stone Golem
warlock.behavior: Warlocks try to attack their opponents at a distance using their powerful spells. They will run at medium health.

wasp.abilities: Melee (0-20), Poison at 1 hp per turn and lasting about 20 hp
wasp.behavior: They do not run away and can retarget.

wild warrior.behavior: Wild Warriors run when in low health.

witch.abilities: Melee (0-20), 0-2 Fire Missiles (30-55), shoots Fire Fields, Changes your appearance into a Green Frog
witch.behavior: Witches always try to stay away from the attacker, so they can burn you with their powerful fire missiles at a distance. They can make you look like a Green Frog.

wolf.behavior: Wolves run from people when they have 8 hitpoints left.
